claim: diagnostic; no gate; no validation claim
inconclusive_reasons: an evidence point is invalid without a valid repeat

method.energy_convention: energy per nucleon = E/A, A = mass number; alternative E/(M/u) tested (M the committed ionmc nuclear mass)
method.fine_step_pattern: 19 limited steps of 0.0515 t, then one boundary-limited step of 0.0215 t (revision 15)
method.method_systematic_composition: 0.1 % table/range construction, 0.1 % per-nucleon energy convention, 0.1 % stepping (linear-branch Euler bias of the fine steps, -0.04 to -0.06 %); quadrature 0.17 %, rounded to 0.2 %
method.point: r_fine: the fine-step run (MaxStepSize 0.0515 t); the one-step pair enters the gate e1 (slab t vs fine) and the report-only quantities e2 and r_0 - r_fine
method.quantity: <Delta E>_T = A E0 - mean(E_exit); predictions RK4 over the slab
method.report_only: e2 (1.6 t vs fine) and r_0 - r_fine carry rho' (the slope of the stopping ratio); not gates
method.stepping_model: P13 record: table part q^2(E_pre) S_base(E) integrated over the one-step slab + correction term at the mid-step energy (C/O); He table part with the full model, q frozen; g(f) = Delta E_alg / Delta E_exact - 1
method.table: libdEdx ICRU73_NEW liquid water (target 276), log-log interpolated

lock.note: versions against uv.lock; bytes sealed separately (environment seal): the numpy distribution (every RECORD-listed file), the interpreter executable, numpy's _multiarray_umath extension, every loaded stdlib module and the launcher are hashed; only the kernel, libc and the C runtime the interpreter links against are outside

rounding_note: mean_r_M, mean_r_I, mean_s, x_b and controls.helium.max_abs_r_m are written rounded to 0.1 percentage point (3 decimals in relative units); the classes and the pattern were computed from the full-precision values (pre-declared).
